native_effect.shared: All bitmap work is existing ImageMetadata/Canvas capture, fixed weighted transition, RGB normalized Byte255Nearest and LinearGradientByte workers. Crossfade selects explicit original default MMX four-RGB-pixel Q7 groups plus scalar Q8 tails; no x86 code executes. Native brightness uses independent round(product/255) lookup contributions. Native even-window11/19 uses independent shared BoxBlurSpan[-before,after); HD40/41 and blur50/51 retain odd2r+1 axis clamping/truncation and ordered horizontal-then-vertical passes via BoxBlurClamped. Mosaic6 uses shared NearestCellSample center-aligned grid top-left samples (not BlockAverage or a giant private rectangle list). All cases preserve common asynchronous resource/PC/final-scene lifecycle. Three blind variants use at most32 clipped immutable RGB-copy regions. Geometric sampling reuses shared PiecewiseResample with exact Q8-to-Q16 representation, zero-step or inferred bilinear sampling is never substituted. No private raster loop, geometry renderer or alternate scene framebuffer. ScanlineAffineNearest is an independent reusable shared two-image Raster operation with bounded row metadata, checked wide or explicit signed32 coordinate wrapping, row cancellation and existing Copy/CopyRgb/mask math; Runtime admits it only in the correct Raster context and charges retained coefficients. TileReveal is a reusable bounded per-cell strict-threshold two-image worker; RadialAngleLookup is a reusable explicit-origins/radius-angle nearest warp. SequenceRng.advance adds bounded logarithmic exact affine skip-ahead, preserving the existing serialized LCG state/next contract. All new metadata contributes to Runtime image admission budgets.
